title: The Category Difference
note: NCCN v6.2026 grades ribociclib category 1 first-line with an aromatase inhibitor and abemaciclib and palbociclib 2A, on the stated basis of ribociclib's overall-survival result. The two drugs' survival results are four hundredths apart with intervals that overlap along 97% of their length; the difference is that one interval stopped at 0.93 and the other at 1.02. Every study that has compared abemaciclib against ribociclib by indirect means finds nothing between them. The guideline's own reasoning is consistent and the piece says so: with fulvestrant, abemaciclib is category 1 on the same standard. The grade records which trial produced a significant survival result, not which drug is better.

gate.note: Eleven runs on the assessment and four on the email, 2026-08-28. Three charges against the guideline were tested and all three withdrawn. Errors the gate caught in our own work include a selective account of the drugs' toxicity, a false reconciliation of two conflicting real-world studies, a one-sided conflict-of-interest disclosure, and a claim that a fact was unknowable when it was in a conference abstract.
